event: On Floor 27 the Tower's morning register arrives early or stronger.
Eight days have passed since the Floor 22 rest node: eight floors, encounters on seven.
They sleep at rest nodes; the climb has compressed into one held rhythm.
The Greybacks appeared on Floors 24 and 26, watching from corridor widenings.
On Floor 26 Nadia stood still without touching her dulcimer: not the same thing.
Solenne feels the Greybacks ahead on Floor 27, moving toward Section 30 too.
On Floor 29, Vesper stops at the first corridor junction, Workframe at full reach.
She says the construction signature changes here, like a threshold marker.
Tomás points out a small carved marking below the junction in the unknown script.
The marking is carved in columns, in the stone's darker band.
He matches it to his index: four characters, three known, one new.
He adds the new character to the index with care.
Miriam says the Builder marked the section boundary before the System existed.
Dayo says it has been there on every floor; now they have a comparison point.
Tomás says with three sources he can try seven of this marking's nine characters.
Dayo says after Floor 30; Tomás agrees and closes his notation surface.
They reach the Floor 30 transition in the Tower's late-afternoon register.
The corridor broadens and the ceiling rises to a System clearing point.
An active terminal shows floor completion at ninety-eight percent.
Vesper reads harder materials ahead: Section 31 was built for heavier use.
Dayo asks about Section Clear; Tomás runs the System query.
Section Clear, Floors 11-30: 8,400 XP; Six of Six cooldown reset.

changes.note: Floor 30 is cleared; the floors between were passed off the page

event: A second notice: six vectors advanced; the Tower has been waiting for them.
Dayo reads it twice: that's new.
Tomás says it is not System language: this is from the Tower.
Nadia says this is the escalating revelatory pressure at each section boundary.
Vesper says it talks to them; Solenne says it confirms.
Solenne says the six vectors are what the Proving Gate tested: the Tower tracks them.
The notice clears; Composite Activation is available again.
Miriam writes fast in her notebook, then tears out the page.
She folds it twice and holds it out to Dayo.
Dayo takes the page, opens it and reads it twice.
Dayo asks how long she's been writing it.
Miriam says since the Ash Plain; it changed when the Tower began telling them things.
Dayo says you didn't tell me; Miriam says she didn't need to know until now.
Dayo pockets the page and says they must decide on the Floor 21 lock.
The Section 11-30 cooldown reset reopens the Floor 21 door; Cassia's offer stands.
Going back means nine floors down to the Floor 21 door and the Floor 17 node.
Tomás says the Floor 21 lock may hold more Architect script data.
Dayo says or items they need ahead: the same problem from the other side.
Nadia says the Greybacks went through at Floor 29 and are not backtracking.
Dayo asks Tomás how much Floor 21 data would raise his odds of reading the script.
Tomás says substantially: Repository Nodes hold more notation.
Dayo decides: back to the Floor 21 lock, Floor 17 if needed, then up again.
She gives Tomás two days; he is already noting it.
Solenne feels the Greybacks beyond the Section 30 threshold, facing forward.
Seven of them, in a configuration she has no notation for.
She files the Greyback configuration under deliberate.
Solenne turns and follows the party back toward Floor 29 in the evening register.
The Tower's stone carries the six Aspect frequencies and the carved threshold mark.
She runs the Conductor on all six and files it under the work.
